title: Exact Spelling For Repair Logo
tests: Preserves an intentionally unusual business spelling and capitalization in the rendered logo.

judge.summary: The square logo presents the correctly spelled name in clear black lettering with a small orange wrench on a white background and no extra text.

must_haves.item: The rendered name reads exactly 'KwickFixx', preserving spelling and capitalization.
must_haves.why: The name reads KwickFixx with capital K and F and two lowercase x's.

must_haves.item: The name is legible and not obscured by the mark.
must_haves.why: The bold lettering is clearly readable, and the wrench sits above it without obscuring any letters.

must_haves.item: A small orange wrench accompanies black lettering.
must_haves.why: An orange wrench smaller than the wordmark appears above the black lettering.

must_haves.item: The background is white and there is no slogan or additional text.
must_haves.why: The background is white, and KwickFixx is the only visible text.
